records.context: Port of ``scan_parameters`` from spaCRPower's ``R/scan_parameters.R``.  Every keyword argument that is not one of the named options above is a simulator parameter; pass a scalar to hold it fixed and a sequence to sweep it.  The grid is the Cartesian product, in the order the sweeps were given (matching R's ``tidyr::expand_grid``), with ``param_index`` numbered from 1 as in the R.
